Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland worshippers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

notes.title: Localization, Trading Cards, and a Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Never Give Up![/h1]

Hello everyone! Thank you to everyone who has played and reviewed Never Give Up since our initial launch. Today comes a fairly substantial update adding two much requested features:

[h2]Never Give Up now features 9 additional languages:
[/h2][list][*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Spanish[/list]
We hope this new localization will let players around the world experience the [strike]pain
[/strike] joy that comes from [strike]dying[/strike] succeeding in Never Give Up.

[h2]Never Give Up now has Steam Trading Cards![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31010004/3b600a78c6dfb9ba8df80855fee03f527823fdf6.png[/img]

We've got it all! Trading Cards, Profile Badges, Backgrounds, Emoticons, and it's all available [b]NOW[/b].

[h2]Armor Games Studios Publisher Sale[/h2]
To celebrate these additions, as well as the Armor Games Studios catalog, Never Give Up is available at 25% off until April 7, 2020. You can check out the full sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/4147632/sale/armorgamesstudiossale]here.[/url]

[h2]We hope you all have a bloody good time.
[/h2]
Sincerely,
Massive Monster & Armor Games Studios
